## Où j'en suis
The team switched from a webhook approach to a polling mechanism for syncing HubSpot company owners and ARR, closing PR #405 and opening PR #409. While the polling logic and windowed pagination are implemented, PR #409 remains open because an e2e test failed after applying the new ARR filter.

- [en-cours] Fix the failing e2e test `test_admin_accounts.py` by updating the fixture for the new ARR > 0 filter.
- [prochaine-étape] Have Noa add the `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging and prod.
- [essai-raté] Managing webhook subscriptions via API failed because private app tokens lack the required permissions.
- [décision] Switch to polling every 15 minutes instead of webhooks (source: t04).
- [décision] Filter out trial companies by only syncing those with ARR > 0 (source: t10).
